places.name: Basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourvière
places.ai_summary: A stunning basilica perched on a hill, offering panoramic views of Lyon and intricate mosaics inside.

opening_hours.notes: Illuminated at night for a spectacular view.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for the best views of the city.

places.name: Vieux Lyon (Old Town)
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site with cobblestone streets, Renaissance buildings, and charming cafes.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and cafes may have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the traboules (hidden passageways) for a unique experience.

places.name: Parc de la Tête d’Or
places.ai_summary: A sprawling urban park with a zoo, botanical gardens, and a serene lake for boating.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for a peaceful stroll.

places.place_tip: Rent a boat to explore the lake during your visit.
places.address: Parc de la Tête d’Or, Lyon, France

places.name: Musée des Confluences
places.ai_summary: A futuristic museum at the confluence of the Rhône and Saône rivers, showcasing science and anthropology.

opening_hours.notes: Free entry on the first Sunday of each month.

places.place_tip: Check out the stunning architecture and the park around the museum.

places.name: Traboules of Lyon
places.ai_summary: Famous hidden passageways used by silk workers, now a unique architectural feature of Lyon.

opening_hours.notes: Some traboules are private, so be respectful of signs.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the history and access private traboules.

places.name: Fourvière Hill & Roman Theatre
places.ai_summary: A historic hill with a Roman theatre, offering some of the best views of Lyon.

opening_hours.notes: The Roman Theatre may have restricted access during events.

places.place_tip: Visit the Roman Theatre for a glimpse into Lyon's ancient history.

attribution.title: La vierge de Fourvière
attribution.author: Gonedelyon
attribution.description: La statue de la vierge dorée descendue de la Chapelle. Fourvière,Lyon

places.name: Halles de Lyon Paul Bocuse (Market)
places.ai_summary: A famous indoor market named after the legendary chef Paul Bocuse, offering gourmet food and local specialties.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for vendor hours, as they can vary.

places.place_tip: Try the local specialties like quenelles and pralines.

places.name: Croix-Rousse District
places.ai_summary: A vibrant district known for its bohemian atmosphere, silk workshops, and the famous mural 'La Fresque des Lyonnais'.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area on foot to fully appreciate the murals and traboules.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the 'La Fresque des Lyonnais' mural.

attribution.author: Pline
attribution.description: Passerelle Saint-Vincent et Saone à Lyon

places.name: Saint-Jean Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A magnificent cathedral known for its stunning stained glass, astronomical clock, and Gothic architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass times, as the cathedral is still active.

places.place_tip: Attend a mass to experience the cathedral's atmosphere fully.

attribution.description: Photo prise depuis les toits de la Basilique Notre-Dame de Fourvière - Primatiale Saint-Jean de Lyon.

places.name: Place des Terreaux
places.ai_summary: A historic square featuring the impressive Bartholdi Fountain and the City Hall of Lyon.

opening_hours.notes: The fountain is illuminated at night.

places.place_tip: Visit the City Hall for a glimpse of Lyon's administrative history.

attribution.title: Place des Terreaux (Lyon, 2025)
attribution.author: Corentin Eustacchi
attribution.description: Vue de la place de nuit et en 2025.

places.name: Museum of Fine Arts of Lyon
places.ai_summary: One of the largest fine arts museums in France, housed in a former Benedictine convent.

opening_hours.notes: Free entry on the first Sunday of each month.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Egyptian antiquities and the modern art section.

places.name: Gallo-Roman Museum of Lyon-Fourvière
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing Lyon's Roman history, located near the ancient theatre on Fourvière Hill.

opening_hours.notes: Free entry on the first Sunday of each month.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the Roman Theatre for a complete experience.

places.name: Confluence Shopping Mall
places.ai_summary: A modern shopping mall located at the confluence of the Rhône and Saône rivers, featuring a wide range of shops and restaurants.

opening_hours.notes: Check individual store hours for specific timings.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal with a view at one of the riverside restaurants.

places.name: Rue de la République
places.ai_summary: A major commercial street in Lyon, known for its 19th-century architecture and vibrant shopping scene.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and cafes may have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for hidden gems and local boutiques.
places.address: Rue de la République, Lyon, France

attribution.title: Rue de la République (Lyon, 2025)
attribution.author: Corentin Eustacchi

places.name: Saône River Walkway
places.ai_summary: A scenic walkway along the Saône River, perfect for a leisurely stroll or bike ride.

opening_hours.notes: Well-lit and safe for evening walks.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a picnic by the river during your visit.

places.name: Opera National de Lyon
places.ai_summary: A renowned opera house in Lyon, known for its impressive architecture and vibrant cultural scene.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for performances and events.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for a performance.
places.address: Place de la Comédie, 69001 Lyon, France

places.name: Grand Hotel-Dieu Complex
places.ai_summary: A historic hospital complex turned luxury hotel and conference center, featuring stunning architecture and gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be restricted during events.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and enjoy a meal at the hotel restaurant.

places.name: Institut Lumière Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the Lumière brothers, pioneers of cinema, located in their childhood home.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and screenings.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the short film screening about the Lumière brothers' inventions.
places.address: 25 Rue du Premier Film, 69008 Lyon, France
